text: Regression in demand ingestion code or deployment :: A bug in the demand payload parsing/validation path is causing valid demand data to be rejected as ingestion errors. :: The fault originates in service:gridcast:ingestion.

Upstream demand data supplier emitting bad payloads :: An upstream demand provider began sending malformed, empty, or schema-incompatible payloads at the incident start. :: The fault originates in the upstream demand data provider.

Demand message queue or event broker delivery failure :: The broker or consumer group serving service:gridcast:ingestion stopped delivering demand messages, causing ingestion failures. :: The fault originates in the demand event broker/queue.

Backing database or datastore write failure :: A database schema issue or write contention is causing demand persistence operations to fail and surface as ingestion errors. :: The fault originates in the backing database/datastore.

Configuration or feature-flag error :: A bad configuration or feature-flag change in service:gridcast:ingestion is pointing demand ingestion at an invalid endpoint or disabling required processing. :: The fault originates in service:gridcast:ingestion configuration.
